name: Turning the shoulder
condition: you want the sword higher or lower
response: hold a shoulder key, and the arm turns for as long as you hold it

name: Bending and straightening the elbow
condition: the target is nearer or farther than your blade
response: straighten the elbow to reach farther, and bend it to pull the blade in

name: The sword carries on
condition: a swing is moving
response: let go of the key before the blade gets where you want it, because the heavy sword keeps turning the arm

name: Stepping
condition: you are too far from your opponent, or too close
response: hold a step key, and the ground carries you that way while the legs keep you upright

name: Jumping
condition: you need to leave the ground
response: press jump: you get one jump from the ground

name: The bounce in the air
condition: you are in the air and still have your second jump
response: press jump to bounce off the air, holding a direction to push that way; a jump late in a fall rises higher, because the fall turns into a rise at the same speed

name: Getting up
condition: you are knocked down and still have both legs
response: press stand

name: Dodging
condition: a blade is about to touch you
response: press dodge so that the moment no blade can cut you covers the touch; your own blade cuts nothing in that moment either

name: Rolling
condition: you want to dodge and change place on the ground
response: hold a direction as you press dodge

name: Dodging in the air
condition: you are in the air and need to get out of the way
response: press dodge to be carried sideways, at the cost of your second jump

name: The wait after a dodge
condition: you dodged a moment ago
response: expect a short wait before the next dodge, so choose the moment rather than pressing again

name: Blocking
condition: a swing is coming at you
response: put your blade in its path, because swords are solid and a blade that meets yours stops

name: What a cut is
condition: your moving blade touches a part of a fighter
response: the blade cuts straight across that part where it touched, and what lies beyond the cut drops off; a slow blade does not cut

name: Where a cut ends the round
condition: you choose where to aim
response: aim across the neck, the head or the heart, because a cut there ends the round

name: Ink
condition: a cut lands somewhere that does not end the round
response: the stump spills ink until the round ends, faster for a larger cut, and a fighter who runs out of ink loses the round

name: Swinging for speed
condition: you need to cross ground fast or leave it
response: swing in one direction again and again: each swing adds speed to your whole fighter

name: Planting the sword
condition: you want to rise or vault
response: put the tip on the ground and straighten the arm; the sword cannot go into the ground, so the push lifts you

name: Reach
condition: the opponent's blade is longer than yours
response: let them swing first and move in while their blade travels, because a longer, heavier blade is slower to start and to stop

name: The opening after a committed move
condition: the opponent has finished a swing, a thrust or a landing
response: attack in that moment, before they can move again

name: A path already chosen
condition: the opponent is in the air or has planted the sword
response: move to where they are not going, and cut where they land

name: Getting around a guard
condition: the opponent holds the sword out in front
response: go over or under the blade, toward the part it does not cover

name: Stopping a turning blade
condition: the opponent keeps the sword turning
response: meet it with a firm block, then strike while they build speed again

name: High against low
condition: an attack comes low, or a guard sits high, or an overhead waits for your jump
response: answer from the other height: over a sweep, under a high guard, and on the ground against an overhead

name: Aim where they do not defend
condition: the opponent dodges attacks at one part of the body
response: aim at another part that still ends the round or drains it

name: Drawing a move
condition: the opponent answers a threat rather than attacking
response: make the threat, let them answer, and strike as the answer ends

name: Your own moves returned
condition: the opponent copies what you did last round
response: do this round what you know how to answer next round

name: A late change
condition: the opponent looks a short time ahead before choosing
response: start a move that looks harmless and change it late

name: Inside their reaction
condition: the opponent reacts some time after you move
response: finish what you start before they can answer it

name: Distance
condition: the opponent keeps away from you, or waits for you to come
response: close in with your guard up, and keep your blade where they will be

name: A guard above
condition: the opponent comes down at you from the air
response: hold your sword above you, because a blade that meets yours stops

name: Light gravity
condition: gravity is weaker than usual
response: jump later and expect to hang longer, for you and for them

name: An opponent with more ink
condition: the opponent has twice your ink
response: go for a cut that ends the round rather than waiting for them to run dry

name: Winning a round
condition: a round starts against an opponent who does not fight back
response: close the distance and land a cut that ends the round

name: Winning a match
condition: an opponent fights back
response: find what they commit to, answer it, and do that again in the next round

name: Watch before you commit
condition: you meet a new opponent
response: watch what they repeat before you attack

name: Compare two opponents
condition: two opponents differ in one thing
response: find that difference, and change the part of your plan it touches
